g.title: UML
g.text: UML Class Diagram – Arena Text-based RPG (PHY10609 / PET10001)
Theo ma nguon thuc te. Gach chan = static · In nghieng = abstract / thuan ao · ◇ aggregation · ◆ composition · ▷ ke thua (is-a) · net dut = phu thuoc

g.title: Character
g.text: # mAttack, mArmor, mLevel, mX, mY: int
+ Character(name: string, maxHealth: int = 100, maxMana: int = 30,
attack: int = 10, armor: int = 0) // auto-adds skill Power Strike
+ getAttack() / getArmor() / getLevel() / getX() / getY() / isAlive()
+ hitTarget(target: Character&, raw: int, action: string, canMiss: bool): int
+ castSkill(index: int, target: Character&, d: Dice&): int

g.title: Weapon
g.text: + Weapon(name: string, value: int, bonusAtk: int)

g.title: Armor
g.text: + Armor(name: string, value: int, bonusArmor: int)

g.title: Potion
g.text: + Potion(name: string, value: int, healAmount: int,

g.title: Skill
g.text: + Skill(skillName: string, mpCost: int, power: int,
+ cast(caster: Character&, target: Character&, d: Dice&): int

g.title: Mage
g.text: + Mage(name, maxHealth, maxMana, attack, armor, spellPower)

g.title: Archer
g.text: + Archer(name, maxHealth, maxMana, attack, armor) // crit 25%

g.title: Spitter
g.text: + performAction(target: Character&, d: Dice&): int // poisons

g.title: Brute
g.text: + Brute(name, maxHealth, maxMana, attack, armor) // miss 25%
+ performAction(target: Character&, d: Dice&): int // may stun

g.title: AmoebaBoss
g.text: + performAction(target: Character&, d: Dice&): int // 3-turn cycle

g.title: Game
g.text: + PHASE_CHOOSE_HERO / BATTLE / REWARD_TYPE / REWARD_PICK / OVER: const int
+ aliveHeroes(): int / isVictory(): bool / canLearnSkill(): bool
+ selectHero(i) / attack(e) / useSkill(s, e) / useItem(k) / defend()

g.title: GameEngine
g.text: - dispatch(cmd: string, a: int, b: int): void
